title: Serial killer
content: Did anyone experience a serial killer / assassin in mall world last night? As well as people trying to protect them from being harmed? (FYI I am not a ceo or dreaming of being killed) but it was very creepy and the scariest dream I’ve had in mall world in a long time… scarier than the natural disaster scenarios… the killer was kinda a blur but should length wavy hair and def a male by body type … wearing all black. No mask or anything but his face was blurry… I kept having random people that were dressed in suites try to protect me or have me hide and let me know where the killer was . It was at the mall , the parking garage , the pier… the bar… many different places and I kept waking up then falling back into the same dream..
